verdict.rationale: Raygun documents an error-status triage workflow. Users can mark error groups Resolved and Ignore them with conditions, including for a specific time period (effectively a snooze), and can change status in bulk from the list. Nothing shows assigning an owner, and nothing shows a resolved issue reopening automatically on regression; deployment tracking to spot regressions is a related feature, not auto-reopen. Missing for 10: assign-owner capability, automatic reopen of resolved issues on regression, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can triage issues — assign an owner, resolve, ignore, or snooze — and the platform reopens a resolved issue automatically when it regresses

citations.quote: Error statuses provides a workflow for triaging and managing your error inbox in Crash Reporting.
Once you've fixed a particular error, you can mark an it as 'Resolved'.
We provide three types of conditions: Ignore for a specific time period ... Ignore for a specific number of occurrences ... Ignore by rule
Select error group/s by clicking the checkbox in the list. Click the 'Change Status' dropdown that appears at the top of the list.
